headline: Fixes to closing and to Maintenance. A won deal closes an item only when the deal is with the person the item is about, and a sent file closes an item only when the file is that item. A reopened item is asked about once, not again with every new clue. An out-of-date Maintenance task is now noticed and brought up to date, your settings file is never overwritten when it cannot be read, and the health check says why a step was left unfinished instead of asking you to run it again. When a scheduled run cannot read your past chats, the Hub says so. Items from the old discuss-later list become tasks only when they read as tasks; the rest are kept as notes. Where an earlier update already turned such items into tasks, a one-time repair can be run by hand to turn them back into notes.
